title: Account Executive
description:
As an Account Executive at CredShields, you will own the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, driving enterprise adoption of next generation offensive security infrastructure. You will engage security leaders, engineering teams, and executive stakeholders to help organizations modernize how they approach application and cloud security.


This is a high impact, execution driven role built for commercially minded operators who thrive in complex technical sales environments and want to operate at the intersection of AI, cybersecurity, and enterprise software.
responsibilities: Own the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting and discovery through product demonstrations, commercial negotiation, and close.
Build and manage pipeline through a combination of self-sourced outbound activity and SDR partnership.
Lead technical and business-focused product demonstrations tailored to customer security and infrastructure environments.
Build trusted relationships with CISOs, security teams, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders across enterprise accounts.
Develop and execute territory and account strategies to drive consistent net-new revenue growth.
Maintain strong pipeline discipline, forecasting accuracy, and CRM hygiene across all active opportunities.
Partner closely with Product and Marketing to strengthen go-to-market execution and customer outcomes.
requirements: 4-6+ years of B2B cybersecurity sales experience with a strong track record of closing deals.
Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across technical and executive buying committees.
Strong ability to communicate technical concepts and translate product capabilities into clear business outcomes and ROI.
Experience with modern GTM tooling including HubSpot, Salesforce, Salesloft, Outreach, Apollo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Self-driven operator with strong outbound discipline, pipeline ownership, and execution consistency.
Familiarity with cybersecurity domains such as penetration testing, vulnerability management, cloud security, or compliance frameworks including SOC2 and ISO 27001.
Comfortable operating in high-growth startup environments without rigid playbooks.
nice_to_have: Proven success selling cybersecurity, infrastructure, or developer-focused products into enterprise environments.
Experience engaging technical stakeholders across security, engineering, DevOps, and platform teams.
Strong understanding of modern cloud-native environments, application security, and DevSecOps workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently build pipeline and close complex enterprise opportunities.
Experience operating across multi-region territories or international enterprise accounts.
Professional fluency in a second language relevant to target markets is a strong advantage.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
As an SDR at CredShields, you will own outbound pipeline generation across target accounts and industries. You will identify, engage, and qualify prospective customers while representing an AI-powered offensive security platform built for modern engineering teams.
This is a fast-paced, execution-driven role designed for highly driven individuals who thrive in high-volume outbound environments and want to operate at the forefront of AI and cybersecurity.
responsibilities: Build and own pipeline through structured outbound prospecting across email, LinkedIn, cold calling, and other channels.
Identify and qualify prospective customers by understanding their security challenges, infrastructure, and buying readiness.
Execute targeted outbound campaigns to engage technical and executive stakeholders across target accounts.
Partner closely with Account Executives to convert qualified prospects into high-quality pipeline opportunities.
Maintain strong CRM hygiene with accurate activity tracking, pipeline management, and forecasting visibility.
Work closely with Marketing to refine targeting, messaging, and outbound performance.
requirements: 2-4+ years of B2B outbound sales or business development experience in cybersecurity.
Proven ability to generate qualified pipelines through cold outbound prospecting and multi-channel outreach.
Strong experience with outbound tooling including LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo/ZoomInfo, CRMs, and sequencing platforms.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders.
Highly organized with strong execution discipline in fast-paced, target-driven environments.
nice_to_have: Highly relevant experience and network to Credshields
Experience engaging technical buyers across cybersecurity, infrastructure, or developer-focused environments, including security, engineering, and DevOps stakeholders.
Ability to quickly understand and clearly communicate technical concepts across cloud security, DevSecOps, API security, and modern application vulnerabilities.
Demonstrated ability to independently build and own pipeline, taking full responsibility for your target territory and outbound performance.
Proven ability to convert cold outreach into high-quality meetings with technical and business decision-makers in complex, fast-moving environments.
Ability to operate with precision, structure, and consistency in ambiguous, high-velocity GTM environments.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description: In this role you'll generate and qualify outbound pipeline across global target accounts, engaging and qualifying prospective customers while representing an AI powered offensive security platform built for modern engineering and security teams. It's an execution focused role suited to ambitious sales professionals who enjoy outbound prospecting and engaging with technical buyers, positioned at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity.
responsibilities: Build and manage outbound pipeline through structured prospecting across email, LinkedIn, cold calling, events, and other channels.
Research target accounts and identify key stakeholders across Security, Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, and Technology leadership teams.
Execute highly personalized outbound campaigns to generate qualified meetings and opportunities.
Qualify prospects by understanding their security challenges, infrastructure environment, current testing processes, and business priorities.
Collaborate with Account Executives to convert qualified prospects into high-quality sales opportunities.
Maintain accurate CRM records, activity tracking, pipeline visibility, and reporting discipline.
Partner with Marketing to optimize messaging, targeting strategies, and outbound performance.
Continuously refine outreach strategies using data, feedback, and market insights.
requirements: 3–4 years of experience in B2B outbound sales, business development, lead generation, or SDR roles.
Experience selling or prospecting into cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, or technology-focused organizations (highly preferred).
Proven ability to generate qualified pipeline through cold outreach and multi-channel prospecting.
Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar tools.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to engage both technical and business stakeholders.
Excellent organizational skills and a disciplined approach to activity management and execution.
Self-motivated, resilient, and comfortable in fast-paced, target-driven environments.
nice_to_have: Experience engaging technical buyers including CISOs, Security Leaders, Engineering Managers, DevOps Leaders, and CTOs.
Curiosity and willingness to learn cybersecurity concepts, cloud security, API security, application security, and DevSecOps.
Ability to understand complex technical topics and communicate their business impact.
Demonstrated success converting cold outreach into meetings with senior decision-makers.
Ownership mindset with the ability to independently build and manage pipeline.
Strong execution discipline and consistency in high-growth, high-velocity GTM environments.
Previous experience in cybersecurity, developer tools, infrastructure software, or enterprise SaaS.

title: Frontend Developer
description: In this role you'll design and build intuitive, scalable, high performance user experiences for the company's AI powered offensive security platform, working closely with product, engineering, design, and security teams to turn complex security workflows into seamless, developer friendly interfaces. It's suited to highly driven engineers who enjoy ownership, move fast, and want to build category defining products at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity.
responsibilities: Build and maintain scalable frontend applications and reusable UI components across the CredShields platform.
Develop responsive, high quality user interfaces with a strong focus on usability, accessibility, and performance.
Translate product requirements and design concepts into production grade frontend experiences.
Collaborate closely with backend, product, and security teams to deliver end-to-end product capabilities.
Integrate frontend applications with APIs and modern service architectures.
Drive improvements in frontend architecture, testing practices, and engineering standards.
Optimize application performance, reliability, and user experience across environments.
Contribute to design systems and frontend best practices that scale with product growth.
requirements: 2–4+ years of experience in frontend development within product, SaaS, or technology-driven environments.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.
Hands-on experience building production applications using React.js and modern frontend frameworks.
Experience with Next.js and component-based architecture.
Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design principles, and browser performance optimization.
Experience integrating REST APIs and managing asynchronous application flows.
Strong understanding of Git workflows and collaborative software development practices.
Excellent problem solving and communication skills with the ability to work cross functionally.
nice_to_have: Highly relevant experience and product mindset aligned with CredShields.
Experience building complex dashboards, workflow heavy applications, or technical platforms.
Strong understanding of frontend scalability, state management, and component driven design.
Experience with Tailwind CSS, design systems, or frontend performance optimization.
Exposure to security first engineering practices and secure frontend development.
Ability to independently own features from concept to production deployment.
Experience operating in fast moving startup environments with strong execution discipline.
Interest or exposure to cybersecurity, DevSecOps, developer tooling, AI products, or modern engineering ecosystems.

title: Marketing Executive/ Manager
description: In this role you'll lead and scale marketing efforts for CredShields One, working closely with founders, product, sales, and design teams to build category awareness, generate qualified pipeline, strengthen brand positioning, and drive growth across digital channels. It's a hands on role suited to someone who understands modern B2B SaaS marketing, cybersecurity positioning, developer first products, and demand generation, and who's excited to build marketing in a fast moving cybersecurity startup.
responsibilities: Brand & Positioning
Develop and strengthen positioning and messaging for CredShields One across digital channels.
Create compelling narratives around AI-powered security testing, continuous pentesting, attack surface management, and DevSecOps workflows.
Build thought leadership through blogs, reports, webinars, case studies, and founder-led content.
Ensure consistent brand communication across websites, social media, campaigns, and sales collateral.
Content & Demand Generation
Own and execute content strategy across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), website, email campaigns, and newsletters.
Create high-quality content including blogs, landing pages, whitepapers, customer stories, and product explainers.
Plan and execute demand generation campaigns targeting CISOs, security teams, engineering leaders, and startups.
Collaborate with sales teams to support lead nurturing and conversion.
Drive organic growth through SEO-focused and product-led content strategies.
Digital Marketing & Growth
Manage and optimize paid and organic marketing campaigns across relevant channels.
Track campaign performance and improve conversion funnels across awareness, engagement, and lead generation stages.
Support website optimization including messaging, user journeys, and conversion improvements.
Analyze marketing metrics such as traffic, engagement, MQLs, CAC, and campaign ROI.
Social Media & Community
Manage CredShields' social presence across LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and other platforms.
Build engagement with cybersecurity, startup, and developer communities.
Coordinate webinars, virtual events, product launches, and ecosystem partnerships.
Monitor industry trends and identify opportunities for brand visibility and strategic collaborations.
Cross-functional Collaboration
Work with product, engineering, and leadership teams to translate technical capabilities into customer-facing value.
Coordinate with designers, video editors, and external partners for campaign execution.
Support PR, media outreach, and analyst relations when required.
requirements: 2–4 years of experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, developer tools, or technology marketing.
Strong understanding of growth marketing, content marketing, and demand generation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience creating marketing content for technical or enterprise audiences.
Familiarity with LinkedIn marketing, SEO, email campaigns, webinars, and marketing analytics.
Experience using tools such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, Canva, Notion, or similar platforms.
Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment with high ownership.
Strong storytelling and campaign execution capabilities.
nice_to_have: Prior experience in cybersecurity, DevSecOps, offensive security, or developer tooling companies.
Experience marketing AI-powered SaaS products.
Exposure to startup ecosystems and founder-led growth.
Experience managing webinars, reports, or technical content marketing.
Understanding of application security, penetration testing, or cloud security concepts.
